hints.title: Window Coverage Properties
hints.text: Consider which elements can appear in exactly one contiguous subarray of size k.

hints.title: Full Array and Single Element Cases
hints.text: When k equals n, every unique element belongs to the single window, so return the maximum element.

hints.title: Boundary Element Evaluation
hints.text: When k is 1, return the maximum element that occurs exactly once. When 1 < k < n, only the boundary elements nums[0] and nums[n - 1] can appear in exactly one window.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Linear scan to compute frequencies and evaluate boundary window coverage.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all subarrays of length k explicitly takes O(n * k) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Analyzing boundary windows directly collapses the problem into constant checks.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify window coverage properties for internal vs boundary elements.
